perspective:
Keith’s available information:

- He is Keith Ndiaye, a male African American construction worker with a bachelor’s degree.
- He knows Elizabeth Sun as the receptionist at the same construction company. They are colleagues with a friendly, professional relationship; he usually interacts with her when he visits the office for paperwork/project updates.
- He observed Elizabeth being unusually curt with him over the past few days.
- He wondered whether he had upset her through a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
- He asked Elizabeth if he had done something to upset her. She told him no, said she was dealing with personal stuff, and apologized if she seemed short.
- He felt sympathetic and offered to listen if she needed someone to talk to. He suggested a coffee break. Elizabeth accepted, thanked him, and said it was kind.
- Over coffee, Elizabeth shared more about her personal stresses; to Keith, they seemed quite severe.
- He told her he appreciated her sharing and asked if she had considered talking to a professional, saying an external perspective can sometimes help. Elizabeth said she had thought about it but was unsure and hesitant about seeking help.
- After that suggestion, he noticed Elizabeth became slightly withdrawn. He believed he might have embarrassed her and felt regretful.
- He told her he hoped he hadn’t overstepped and that he was there to support her. Elizabeth said he hadn’t overstepped, she appreciated his concern, and it was just a lot to think about.
- Later, he observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He believes she values his support and feels more comfortable around him.
- He told her he was glad they talked and that he is always available if she needs to chat or take a break. Elizabeth thanked him, said it meant a lot, and said she felt better knowing she had his support.
- Keith intends to maintain this supportive relationship.

Keith does not have access to Elizabeth’s private thoughts, the full causes/details of her stress beyond what she told him, or any events he did not personally observe or hear about.
